sendVerificationEmail = async (email, token) => { const config = getConfig(); const verifyLink = `${config.corsOrigin}/auth/verify-email/${token}`; const html = `

Verify Your Email

Thanks for signing up! Click the button below to verify your email address.

Verify Email

If you didn't create an account, you can safely ignore this email.

`; return sendEmail({ to: email, subject: 'Verify your email address', html }); }

sendPasswordResetEmail = async (email, resetToken) => { const config = getConfig(); const resetLink = `${config.corsOrigin}/auth/reset-password?token=${resetToken}`; const html = `

Reset Your Password

We received a request to reset your password. Click below to set a new one.

Reset Password

This link expires in 1 hour.

`; return sendEmail({ to: email, subject: 'Reset your password', html }); }
